svg.aria-label: Nyquist plot of 500 over (s + 1)(s + 3)(s + 10): it starts at 16.67 on the real axis, crosses the negative imaginary axis at minus j8.36 when omega is 1.46, and crosses the negative real axis at minus 0.874 when omega is 6.56; the mirror image covers negative frequencies; the minus 1 point is not encircled, so the closed loop is stable

g.text: solid: ω from 0 to ∞ · dashed: ω from −∞ to 0 · −1 not encircled → stable, GM = 1.14
